很.english: very; quite; (also, often used before an adjective without intensifying its meaning, i.e. as a meaningless syntactic element)

電.english: lightning; electricity; electric (bound form); to get (or give) an electric shock; phone call or telegram etc; to send via telephone or telegram etc

從.english: surname Cong; from; through; via; (bound form) to follow; (bound form) to obey; (bound form) to engage in (an activity); (used before a negative) ever; (bound form) (Taiwan pr. [zong4]) retainer; attendant; (bound form) (Taiwan pr. [zong4]) assistant; auxiliary; subordinate; (bound form) (Taiwan pr. [zong4]) related by common paternal grandfather or earlier ancestor

走.english: to walk; to go; to run; to move (of vehicle); to visit; to leave; to go away; to die (euph.); from; through; away (in compound verbs, such as 撤走[che4 zou3]); to change (shape, form, meaning)

彩.english: (bright) color; variety; applause; applaud; lottery prize

前.english: front; forward; ahead; first; top (followed by a number); future; ago; before; BC (e.g. 前293年); former; formerly

早.english: early; morning; Good morning!; long ago; prematurely

想.english: to think (about); to think of; to devise; to think (that); to believe (that); to desire; to want (to); to miss (feel wistful about the absence of)

團.english: round; lump; ball; to roll into a ball; to gather; regiment; group; society; classifier for a lump or a soft mass: wad (of paper), ball (of wool), cloud (of smoke)

拜.english: to bow to; to pay one's respects; (bound form) to extend greetings (on a specific occasion); to make a courtesy call; (bound form) (of a monarch) to appoint sb to (a position) by performing a ceremony; to acknowledge sb as one's (master, godfather etc); (used before some verbs to indicate politeness)

聽.english: to listen to; to hear; to heed; to obey; a can (loanword from English "tin"); classifier for canned beverages; to let be; to allow (Taiwan pr. [ting4]); (literary) to administer; to deal with (Taiwan pr. [ting4])

卻.english: but; yet; however; while; to go back; to decline; to retreat; nevertheless; even though

像.english: to resemble; to be like; to look as if; such as; appearance; image; portrait; image under a mapping (math.)

讓.english: to yield; to permit; to let sb do sth; to have sb do sth; to make sb (feel sad etc); by (indicates the agent in a passive clause, like 被[bei4])

歌聲.english: singing voice; fig. original voice of a poet

落差.english: drop in elevation; (fig.) gap (in wages, expectations etc); disparity

一個.english: a; an; one; the whole (afternoon, summer vacation etc)

只有.english: only have ...; there is only ...; (used in combination with 才[cai2]) it is only if ... (that one can ...) (as in 只有通過治療才能痊愈|只有通过治疗才能痊愈[zhi3 you3 tong1 guo4 zhi4 liao2 cai2 neng2 quan2 yu4] "the only way to cure it is with therapy"); it is only (someone) who ... (as in 只有男性才有此需要[zhi3 you3 nan2 xing4 cai2 you3 ci3 xu1 yao4] "only men would have such a requirement"); (used to express lack of alternatives) can only; have no choice but to (as in 只有屈服[zhi3 you3 qu1 fu2] "the only thing you can do is give in")

一樣.english: same; like; equal to; the same as; just like

有人.english: someone; people; anyone; there is someone there; occupied (as in restroom)

最後.english: final; last; ultimate; finally; in the end

時候.english: time; length of time; moment; period

往前.english: (in) the past; ahead; forward; in the future

出來.english: to come out; to appear; to arise; (after a verb, indicates coming out, completion of an action, or ability to discern or detect)

以為.english: to think; to believe (often with the implication that the belief is mistaken – unless referring to one's own current belief)

小小.english: very small; very few; very minor
